$comment: Which mascot pose fills which landing-page slot, and where each one is cut from — plus
the library of supplied poses that fill no slot yet. public/mascot/poses/ is NOT fully
machine-owned: `poses` below are cut by scripts/mascot/extract.js and nothing else may
write those five files; `supplied` are hand-cut PNGs the project owner pasted in directly
(background removed, cropped) — extract.js never touches them and never will, since a
human edit is not reproducible by re-running an extractor. Either way, every file on disk
has a record here, so an asset's provenance is always this manifest plus either the sheet
a `poses` entry names or the `origin` a `supplied` entry gives (spec 5.2: a slot may only
be filled from a source whose origin is recorded).
A `poses` entry is addressed by an `anchor` — a point inside the drawing on the source
sheet — not by an index, so re-running after a change to the segmentation still resolves
to the same character. `node scripts/mascot/extract.js` rewrites its five outputs in
public/mascot/poses/ from this file.
`fade` dissolves the bottom of the crop over [from,to] as a fraction of height. The orb
poses are drawn with the orb's warm light spilling onto a ground plane; cut straight,
that spill reads as an opaque plate the character sits on. Fading it out keeps the glow
and loses the plate.
`width` is the exported pixel width — roughly 3x the largest size the slot renders at,
so the asset holds up on a high-DPI screen without shipping the whole 3072px sheet.
`supplied` entries carry no `slot`: they are a library to pick from, not placements. If
one is later wired into a component, add a `slot` to its `supplied` entry — it does not
migrate to `poses`, which is reserved for assets extract.js itself cuts from a sheet.

poses.caption: VẪY TAY — waving
poses.slot: §1 hero, Companion card. The companion's first appearance on the page, so it waves. Renders ~48px, which is why a pose with a clear silhouette beats a detailed one.

poses.caption: GHI LẠI — writing it down
poses.slot: §4 pitch showcase, Companion card. The card is the companion commenting on your pitch, so the pose is it taking notes on what it heard.

poses.caption: ÔM KÝ ỨC — holding a memory
poses.slot: §6 capability chain, at the end of the chain under "Korume remembers. You grow." The pose is literally the companion holding a memory orb.

poses.caption: NHÌN XA — looking into the distance
poses.slot: §8 CTA, the largest placement. Keeps the glowing-orb motif the reference uses here, and the gaze points at what the section is asking for — the next step.

poses.caption: NGỦ GỤC — asleep, with a Zzz
poses.slot: §10 footer mascot card. The frame names this image KorumeSleepingPeacefullyOnABook (347:7101) and §9 directly above it reads "The day can end softly", so the frame and the copy both ask for a sleeping pose — not the farewell wave a footer would otherwise suggest.
